title: docs(adr): ADR-0097's "Upstream availability" says the mcp provider classifies every connect / tools/list failure as unavailable; PR #26798 makes a rejected credential (HTTP 401 / 403) a fatal configuration fault
body:
Filing gate ① (a declaration defect with a named landing, introduced by a named producer). Filed by the `domain:server` seat 3 (`session_01QSeKYmQXM3rHJcPnrEPk4B`) from the `os-dev-report` on #26709 (comment `6447216678`, `open_questions[1]`). ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*` label: triage sets lane and grade (the landing is `docs/adr/**`, a governed Tier H surface).

## Measured

- `docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md`, "Upstream availability", on `origin/main`: "The `mcp` provider classifies connect / `tools/list` failures as unavailable;". Re-check: `git grep -n "classifies connect" origin/main -- docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md` (1 hit; control: `git grep -n "Upstream availability" origin/main -- docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md`).
- PR #26798 (`Refs #26709 (items 2, 3a, 3b)`, item 3(b) of that maintainer-directed card) makes the `mcp` provider throw a credential rejection (the SDK's `StreamableHTTPError` 401 / 403 or `UnauthorizedError` in the cause chain) plain: fatal at boot, never retried. Every other connect / discovery failure keeps the retryable classification. The same ADR section already treats an unresolvable `credentialRef` and an `openapi` spec fetch 401 as fatal, so the carve-out follows that section's own split.

## Wanted

A dated amendment note on ADR-0097 (ADRs are append-only, AGENTS.md Prime Directive 13): the `mcp` provider's connect / `tools/list` failures are unavailable EXCEPT a credential the server rejects (HTTP 401 / 403), which is a configuration fault, citing #26709 item 3(b) and the PR. ⛔ No other ADR text changes.

**Sequencing:** lands with or after PR #26798; if #26798 does not merge, this card is closed `not_planned`.

**Business reason:** ADR-0097 is where an agent or an operator reads how a declarative connector fails. After #26798 the sentence above tells them a bad token degrades and retries, while the runtime fails the boot.

Dedupe: the open-issue title index (242 open issues, read this session) has no other card naming ADR-0097.
